source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of data security in blockchain (PDF 167-168).

blocks.text: Blockchain data ki hifazat ahem khat mehfooz tareeqe se bhejne jaisi hai.

blocks.caption: Band khat ki misal
rows: band lifafa jo sirf dost khol sake
sirf key wale data parh sakte hain
lifafe par aap ka pehchana signature
bhejne wale aur be-tabdeeli ka saboot
har qadam likhne wala bharosemand courier
har chhed-chhaar pakri aur radd hoti hai
ek node par hamla ho to bhi data bachta hai

blocks.alt: Oopar: supplier, manufacturer, fabricator, intermediary, retailer aur customer ki supply chain, har hawalgi mushtarak ledger ki line par record se juri. Neeche baen: plain text key ke saath encryption se cipher text aur key ke saath decryption se wapas, band khat ki misal ke saath. Neeche daen: edge computing, serverless, Blockchain 2.0, AI aur blockchain, IoT aur blockchain ek ek line ke notes ke saath.
blocks.caption: Product tracking, encryption aur mustaqbil ke rujhanat (topics 6.5 aur 6.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Chocolate jaisa product supplier se manufacturer, fabricator, intermediary, retailer aur customer tak jata hai, aur har hawalgi mushtarak ledger par darj hoti hai, to customer product ka asal maakhaz dekh sakta hai. Encryption key se parhne ke qabil plain text ko cipher text banati hai, aur durust key se decryption use wapas badalti hai; digital signatures, record rakhne wale network aur kai copies ke saath yeh blockchain data ko parhna, jaali banana ya badalna mushkil rakhti hai. Mustaqbil ke rujhanat mein data ke qareeb edge computing, serverless computing, smart contracts aur decentralized apps wala Blockchain 2.0, aur AI aur IoT ke saath blockchain shamil hain.

blocks.text: Mil kar encryption, digital signatures, record rakhne wala network aur kai copies ghair mujaz logon ke liye blockchain data parhna ya badalna bohat mushkil banate hain. Amazon aur Microsoft jaisi bari companies bhi apne computers se blockchain networks chalane mein madad deti hain (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Class activity: dost ke liye khufia code mein paigham likhein jise woh hal kare. Is ka encryption se kya rishta hai?
blocks.explanation: Maslan har harf 3 jagah aage (A se D): HELLO se KHOOR. Dost 3 wapas kar ke hal karta hai. Shift hi key hai: is ke baghair sirf be-tarteeb text nazar aata hai, yahi encryption ka khayal hai. Yeh Caesar cipher ki misal aam ilm hai.

items: Blockchain ki hifazat: encryption, digital signatures, record rakhne wala network, decentralization.
